description.value:
This handmade wood pendant light combines contemporary industrial design with a mid-century modern feeling. What is so unique about this lamp is the fact that it creates streams of shadow and light on the ceiling and walls. The stronger the light, the bigger the casting shadows.

UMBRELLA has everything you need to change your whole home decor. With its mid-century design and warm illumination, this light fixture is the ideal accent to any living area, creating a comfortable and welcoming ambiance.  Let yourself be inspired! Just choose your favorite design and start updating your interior today!

All umbrella pendant lights come with gold pins, which convey a refined finish and a touch of luxury.
Each of our wood chandelier lights comes with our handmade wooden ceiling cup. A picture of our ceiling cup has been listed in the picture section for you to have a closer look at. We aim to provide a full Dezaart experience to our customers. 

Looking for a pendant light that’s stylish, modern, and unique? We also have a selection of on-trend patterns, like floral, stripes, and geometric, in a wide variety of colors and textures, suiting every style and place.
https://www.etsy.com/listing/1611419239/terraco-black-umbrella-wood-pendant

 
All our wood light fixtures have been carefully created by us, in our family workshop in Greece, using sustainable wood and promoting environmentally friendly practices, helping to protect forests, reduce deforestation, and combat climate change.
－ － － －DIMENSIONS － － － －Height / Diameter
►Small Size : 8in x 19in  /  20cm x 48 cm
►Large Size : 12in x 23in  / 29cm x 58 cm
Each of our wood chandelier lighting comes with our own handmade black ceiling cup, which provides a full Dezaart experience to our customers.
► Ceiling Cup Dimensions: 14cm (5.6in)


－ － － －ASSEMBLE － － － －Assembly is required! Your pendant light will be shipped with fully detailed instructions on how to assemble it. No glue or screws are needed, and it can be done in just 5-10 minutes. The reason for this is safer transportation and cheaper shipping costs for the buyer

YouTube tutorial on assembling and adjusting the pendant light, ceiling cup, and cord here:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=00IsxP-cYtE
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zBPVQchr170

－ － － －INSTALATTION － － － －Up to 60W lamp holder voltage: E27 / E26
110-220V comes with a 1m (40in) cord
LIGHT BULB NOT INCLUDED!
► We can accommodate a plug-in version, with a longer or shorter cord.
You just have to leave a note in the comment section of your order.
Up to 3 meters is free of charge for every extra meter, plus 5 euros.
